name: Siblings
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of loving and caring for siblings as a reflection of godly character. Believers are commanded not to harbor hatred or anger toward their brothers, but to lovingly correct and protect them from sin, recognizing that a brother is a source of support in adversity. Jesus expands the concept of siblinghood to include all who do the will of the Father, calling His followers to love one another with the same selfless love He demonstrated.
